about: Employer job boards Cincinnatus checks out of the box, so the app returns real results with zero setup. Every slug was verified live: HTTP 200, a non-empty jobs array, and a board name matching the intended employer. The name check matters - several plausible slugs return 200 with real postings but belong to a different company entirely (greenhouse/archer is a veterinary clinic, ashby/flock is a UK motor insurer). Re-verify with: pnpm harness --verify-watchlist
coverage_gap: Many employers a veteran would name first - Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, RTX, Leidos, Booz Allen, GDIT, USAA, Peraton, CACI, V2X - run on Workday, BrassRing, Phenom or iCIMS. None of those is an approved source, and reaching them would mean scraping, which this project does not do. This list is therefore not a complete picture of veteran hiring, and the app says so rather than implying otherwise.
